raw.query: WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid = true), v AS (SELECT n_images, mean_ms FROM f WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_dense.json' AND image_px = 448), s AS (SELECT n_images, mean_ms, aic_pred_ms, ratio_meas_over_aic FROM f WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/anchor_dense_sdpa_2400.json' AND image_px = 448), c AS (SELECT n_images, mean_ms FROM f WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vit_compile_dense.json' AND image_px = 448), vb AS (SELECT v.n_images, v.mean_ms / s.aic_pred_ms AS ratio FROM v JOIN s USING (n_images) WHERE s.aic_pred_ms IS NOT NULL), ord AS (SELECT c.n_images, c.mean_ms BETWEEN v.mean_ms AND s.mean_ms AS between FROM c JOIN v USING (n_images) JOIN s USING (n_images)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vb) AS vllm_denominator_rows, (SELECT MAX(ABS(ratio -
